title: Tensor products of finitely presented scheme module sheaves are finitely presented
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and let $F,G$ be sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules on its Zariski site [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. A sheaf $H$ is finitely presented if every point has an open neighbourhood $U$ with an exact sequence $\mathcal O_U^m\to\mathcal O_U^n\to H|_U\to0$ for finite nonnegative integers $m,n$. If $F$ and $G$ are finitely presented, then their sheaf tensor product $F\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}G$ [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] is finitely presented.

proof.text: For two finitely presented R-modules M and N, use Mathlib Module.finitePresentation_iff_exists_presentation to obtain presentations p and q with finite generator and relation types. Module.Presentation.tensor constructs the presentation with generators p.G × q.G and relations (p.R × q.G) ⊕ (p.G × q.R). These types are finite, so Module.Presentation.finitePresentation gives finite presentation of M ⊗_R N. This is the private helper finitePresentation_tensor; it has a complete proof and uses no new assumption.

proof.text: On Spec R, put M = Γ(F,top) and N = Γ(G,top). Finite presentation of their sections follows from [lem-weil-pbc-finite-presentation-affine-sections], with the scalar ring transported along Γ(Spec R,top) ≅ R by finitePresentation_sections_top. Since finite presentation implies quasi-coherence, [lem-weil-pbc-affine-tilde-gamma-adjunction] identifies tilde M with F and tilde N with G. By [lem-weil-pbc-affine-tilde-tensor], tilde(M ⊗_R N) is isomorphic to F ⊗ G. Step 1 gives finite generators and relations for M ⊗_R N. Mathlib presentationTilde applies the colimit-preserving tilde functor to their finite presentation, and its generator and relation index types remain those finite sets. Presentation.isFinitePresentation and transport along the comparison isomorphism give finite presentation of F ⊗ G on Spec R.

source.place: Tag 01CE, lemma-tensor-product-permanence (4), via affine module presentations; affine comparison from Schemes Tags 01I7, 01IA and 01IB.

proof.text: Take the cover of X by all affine opens, represented by the open immersions Spec Γ(X,U) → X. Restriction preserves the finite presentations of F and G: it preserves colimits and the structure module [lem-weil-pbc-module-restriction-open-immersion-colimits], as implemented by isFinitePresentation_restrictFunctor. By [lem-weil-pbc-module-restriction-tensor-comparison], restriction of F ⊗ G is isomorphic to the tensor of the restricted factors. Step 2 and invariance under isomorphism therefore make every such restriction finitely presented. The restriction/pullback comparison and isFinitePresentation_of_isOpenImmersion glue these local finite presentations over the affine cover. No flatness is used; empty schemes and empty finite generator/relation types are permitted.
